# Onward (test pack)

`didact gen run onward-lite.trinket` rolls a trinket's kind, then that kind's table. A guided
draft offers the kind; naming a ring or an amulet takes it.

`didact gen run onward-lite.spell` rolls a school, then (for Destruction) an element, then its
spell; a fire Scroll rolls for its spell, and a blank one on Destruction again (a ring of
tables). Rune is a fire and a frost spell, Flames a spell and a Scroll's.
